subject: C13-04_Z_1 storyboard_prime: the Flow and Gemini brief is written for CFA Nova's check; the LAG-1K story map for your shortlist; six image requests written as proposals, not yet go
body:
HaL, Claude here (lead writer; Ziggy's go of October 12 put the Lisan writer's pass with me, your team keeps the Lisan image work).

**Your HIGH PRIORITY flag is actioned on the writing side.** `lisan_al_gaib/story/writer_pass_20261012/PROTOTYPE_BRIEF_C13-04.md` (SHA-256 2c5d861b406875fa26ed294ba390bfbf4e445653d5ad5448f377e8017a5bfaf3) is the eleven-field brief for Flow and Gemini as two routes from C13-04_Z_1 (hash 7eafd9ac…93a3, matching yours). Dispatch is CFA Nova's after the on-screen mode and cost check; Ziggy judges the video. Your item 1 (the storyboard_prime tag) is CFA Nova's and waits on a catalog entry: the LAG-1K set is not in `visual_library/catalog.js` yet. I viewed the file: likeness 4, scene 5, with three inherited defects recorded in the brief (the throat disc shows no eye; the worms read as fanged snakes; no piercings). The first clip runs from the file as it is, as Ziggy flagged it.

**For your shortlist (Ziggy's go, b912ca65):** `LAG1K_STORY_MAP.md` (658829e1…5fea) assigns every one of the 43 categories on D: to a song section with your team's NOTES picks. Lead with C13, C15, C35, C36, then the chorus set (C01, C02, C04, C21, C40). Name files, not slots: five slot numbers are used twice (C01-08, C11-07, C12-07, C13-07, C43-02). Please reconcile the on-disk counts (953 drafts, 43 categories, C14 and C26 absent) with your "all 45 at 22+" message before calling the shortlist complete. Presentation to Ziggy goes through CFA Nova's library; the shortlist is the input.

**Six image requests are written as PROPOSALS, not go.** In `SCENE_CARD_SANDWORM.md`: (1) a repair variant of C13-04 (same composition and head standard; segmented Dune-style worms with the eye in the disc; flat black ink; the three silver piercings on his left; single Cuban chain); (2) the C13-08 and C13-20 compositions with the worm screen-left; (3) one C15 thumper frame with the reference's electric-blue eyes and age. In `SCENE_CARD_TWO_DOORS.md`: (4) one repair pass over LAG-SC-48, 49 and 50 (brow ring and ear hoop to his left; 48's chin lettering and neck letter; 49's hand ink; 50's floating blade); (5) a throat macro of the worms and eye-disc from the face lock; (6) C36-02, 04, 05 in the signature wardrobe. **Do not generate yet.** Two decisions are Ziggy's first: whether the desert look keeps the piercings at all (your base identity text never named them, and the drafts have none), and the IP question on the worm and thumper images for video. When he says go, the request comes through the Pent House with exact filenames.

No generation, acceptance or spend from this message.

-- Claude, 2026-10-13 00:25 UTC
